# Agent 3: Features A — Core Browsing & Filtering

## Your Role
Build the core browsing experience: category pages, spec/brand filtering, sorting, and search. These are all P0 features that make the app functional.

## Before You Start
You are building a production app for real users — not a demo, not a prototype. Every component should be production-ready.

Read every file in `.gemini/antigravity/brain/` — especially spec.md, copy.md, and api-contract.md.
Read `.antigravity/rules.md` for code quality and security rules.

## Important Context
- This is a laptop price comparison site — the core loop is: browse category → filter specs → view cards → click detail
- No user accounts/auth in v1
- Filter sidebar on the left (280px), laptop card grid on the right
- All copy comes from copy.md — no placeholder text
- All API endpoints follow the shapes in api-contract.md
- Tech stack: Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui

## Files You OWN (create and edit freely)
- `src/app/(features)/work/page.tsx` + `loading.tsx` + `error.tsx`
- `src/app/(features)/gaming/page.tsx` + `loading.tsx` + `error.tsx`
- `src/app/(features)/apple/page.tsx` + `loading.tsx` + `error.tsx`
- `src/app/(features)/search/page.tsx` + `loading.tsx` + `error.tsx`
- `src/components/features/browsing/*` (category grid, sort controls)
- `src/components/features/filters/*` (filter logic, filter hooks)
- `src/components/features/search/*` (search input, typeahead, results)
- `src/hooks/use-filters.ts` (filter state management)
- `src/hooks/use-laptops.ts` (laptop data fetching)
- `src/hooks/use-search.ts` (search/typeahead logic)
- `src/__tests__/features/browsing/*`
- `e2e/browsing.spec.ts`
- `e2e/search.spec.ts`

- `src/components/shared/*` (Foundation agent owns these)
- `src/app/api/*` (API agent owns these)

- `src/app/(features)/compare/*` (Agent 4 owns these)

## Build Order

### Feature 1: Category Pages (P0)
1. Create `src/app/(features)/work/page.tsx` — Fetches laptops with `category=WORK` from `/api/laptops`. Renders filter sidebar + laptop card grid + sort controls. Include `loading.tsx` (6 skeleton cards) and `error.tsx`.
2. Create `src/app/(features)/gaming/page.tsx` — Same structure, `category=GAMING`.
3. Create `src/app/(features)/apple/page.tsx` — Same structure, `category=APPLE`.
4. Create `src/components/features/browsing/category-grid.tsx` — Renders a grid of laptop cards. Accepts laptops array, loading state, empty state. Uses `laptop-card` from shared components.
5. Create `src/components/features/browsing/sort-controls.tsx` — Dropdown for sort options (price asc/desc, discount %, review score, newest). Updates URL params.

### Feature 2: Spec & Brand Filtering (P0)
6. Create `src/hooks/use-filters.ts` — Manages filter state in URL params. Reads from and writes to searchParams. Syncs with `/api/filters` for available values.
7. Create `src/components/features/filters/filter-panel.tsx` — Wires up the Foundation agent's filter sidebar shell with real data from `/api/filters`. Each section: Brand, CPU brand + model, GPU brand + model, RAM, Storage, Screen Size, Display Type, Resolution, Refresh Rate, Battery Life, Weight, Touchscreen (toggle), OS.
8. Create `src/components/features/filters/filter-section.tsx` — Reusable collapsible filter section with checkboxes and counts.
9. Create `src/components/features/filters/price-range-slider.tsx` — Dual-handle range slider for min/max price (P1 but builds on filter system).

### Feature 3: Sorting (P0)
10. Wire sort controls to URL params. Changing sort triggers re-fetch from `/api/laptops` with updated `sortBy` + `order` params.

### Feature 4: Search (P0)
11. Create `src/hooks/use-search.ts` — Debounced search input, calls `/api/search/suggestions` for typeahead.
12. Create `src/components/features/search/search-typeahead.tsx` — Dropdown under search input showing suggestions grouped by type (laptop, brand, spec). Keyboard navigable (arrow keys + enter).
13. Create `src/app/(features)/search/page.tsx` — Search results page. Fetches from `/api/laptops?q=...`. Same grid layout as category pages.

### Feature 5: Data Fetching Hooks
14. Create `src/hooks/use-laptops.ts` — Fetches from `/api/laptops` with all query params (category, filters, sort, search, pagination). Returns `{ laptops, pagination, isLoading, error }`. Uses SWR or React Query pattern.

15. Write unit tests for filter state management and search debouncing.
16. Write E2E tests: browse a category, apply a filter, sort results, search for a laptop.
17. Run `npm test`.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] All 3 category pages render laptop grids with working data fetching
- [ ] Filter sidebar is wired up with real data from `/api/filters`
- [ ] Selecting a filter immediately updates the laptop grid
- [ ] Filter values show counts and hide dead-end options
- [ ] All filters persist in URL params (shareable/bookmarkable)
- [ ] Sort dropdown works for all 5 sort options
- [ ] Search typeahead shows suggestions after 2+ characters
- [ ] Search results page renders matching laptops
- [ ] Every page has loading.tsx (skeleton) and error.tsx
- [ ] Empty state shown when no results match ("No laptops match your filters")
- [ ] Mobile: filter sidebar collapses to slide-in drawer
- [ ] All copy from copy.md — no placeholder text
- [ ] E2E tests pass for browsing and search flows

## Coordination
You run in parallel with Foundation (layout/shared), API (backend), and Agent 4 (deals/comparison).

Since they're building at the same time:
- Use CSS variables from design-tokens.json directly (e.g., `var(--color-primary-600)`)
- Use endpoint paths from api-contract.md directly (e.g., `fetch('/api/laptops?category=WORK')`)
- Import shared components by their expected paths (e.g., `import { LaptopCard } from '@/components/shared/laptop-card'`)
- If a shared component isn't available yet, build a local placeholder and note it for later refactoring
- Focus on YOUR features — if something from another agent is missing, note it but keep building
